formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (N Jn : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (Ckt : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (fa fb : Fin Jn → ℕ) (fr : ℕ), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 Ckt → (∀ jd : Fin Jn, (Ckt.lineDegrees (N + N) (Finset.Ico N (N + N))).getD (fa jd) 0 ≤ 2 ∧ (Ckt.lineDegrees (N + N) (Finset.Ico N (N + N))).getD (fb jd) 0 ≤ 1) → (∀ (jb : Fin Jn) (zz : Fin (N + N) → Bool), (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn zz)).getD (fa jb) false = true → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn zz)).getD (fb jb) false = true → ∃ (pa lb : Fin N), I pa lb ∧ zz (Fin.castAdd N pa) = true ∧ zz (Fin.natAdd N lb) = true) → (Finset.univ.filter (fun e2 : Fin N × Fin N => I e2.1 e2.2 ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (N + N) => if vq = Fin.castAdd N e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd N e2.2 then true else false))).getD fr false = false ∧ (∃ jc : Fin Jn, (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (N + N) => if vq = Fin.castAdd N e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd N e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fa jc) false = true ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (N + N) => if vq = Fin.castAdd N e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd N e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fb jc) false = true) ∧ ∀ jk : Fin Jn, (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (N + N) => if vq = Fin.castAdd N e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd N e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fa jk) false = true → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (N + N) => if vq = Fin.castAdd N e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd N e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fb jk) false = true → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vp : Fin (N + N) => decide (vp = Fin.castAdd N e2.1)))).getD (fa jk) false = false ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vp : Fin (N + N) => decide (vp = Fin.castAdd N e2.1)))).getD (fb jk) false = false)).card ≤ 100 * (Ckt.size + Jn) + 4 * N)
plain_statement: Is there an incidence of N points and N lines, no two points on two common lines, an AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two, a wire r and J pairs (a_j, b_j) of wires, a_j of line-degree at most 2, b_j at most 1, each a_j AND b_j true only where an incident point and line are on, with more than 100 (size + J) + 4N diagonal pairs: incident (p, w) where, at p and w alone on, r is false, some a_j and b_j are both true, and each such j has a_j and b_j false at p alone? Line-degree: line 1, point 0, AND the sum, OR the maximum. Conjecture that none exists.
title: Search: a counterexample to the diagonal lemma at line-degree 3 with the constants 100 and 4
